lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee kee vaar mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਣੀਦਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਡੀਠੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa satigur suneedaa taiso hee mai deeth ||
lines.translation: As I have heard of the True Guru, so I have seen Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਬਸੀਠੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vichhuRiaa mele prabhoo har daragah kaa baseeth ||
lines.translation: He re-unites the separated ones with God; He is the Mediator at the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ਕਟੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naamo ma(n)tr driRaaidaa kate haumai rog ||
lines.translation: He implants the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and eradicates the illness of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਪਇਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur tinaa milaaiaa jinaa dhure paiaa sa(n)jog ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he alone meets the True Guru, who has such union pre-ordained. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik sajan sabh sajanaa ik vairee sabh vaad ||
lines.translation: If the One Lord is my Friend, then all are my friends. If the One Lord is my enemy, then all fight with me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai dekhaaliaa vin naavai sabh baad ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has shown me that, without the Name, everything is useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਜੋ ਲਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat durajan bharamiaa jo lage doojai saad ||
lines.translation: The faithless cynics and the evil people wander in reincarnation; they are attached to other tastes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har prabh bujhiaa gur satigur kai parasaad ||2||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has realized the Lord God, by the Grace of the Guru, the True Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਟਣਹਾਰੈ ਥਾਟੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਥਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: thatanahaarai thaat aape hee thatiaa ||
lines.translation: The Creator Lord created the Creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape pooraa saahu aape hee khatiaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the perfect Banker; He Himself earns His profit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape kar paasaar aape ra(n)g ratiaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself made the expansive Universe; He Himself is imbued with joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਅਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kudarat keem na paai alakh brahamatiaa ||
lines.translation: The value of God's almighty creative power cannot be estimated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam athaah bea(n)t parai paratiaa ||
lines.translation: He is inaccessible, unfathomable, endless, the farthest of the far.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਡ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਜੀਰਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape vad paatisaahu aap vajeeratiaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the greatest Emperor; He Himself is His own Prime Minister.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੀਮ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: koi na jaanai keem kevad matiaa ||
lines.translation: No one knows His worth, or the greatness of His resting place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib aap guramukh paragatiaa ||1||
lines.translation: He Himself is our True Lord and Master. He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sajan preetam meriaa mai satigur dehu dikhaal ||
lines.translation: Listen, O my beloved friend: please show me the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau tis devaa man aapanaa nit hiradai rakhaa samaal ||
lines.translation: I dedicate my mind to Him; I keep Him continually enshrined within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikas satigur baaharaa dhrig jeevan sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Without the One and Only True Guru, life in this world is cursed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak satigur tinaa milaaion jin sad hee varatai naal ||1||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru, with whom He constantly abides. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai a(n)tar lochaa milan kee kiu paavaa prabh tohi ||
lines.translation: Deep within me is the longing to meet You; how can I find You, God?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee aisaa sajan loR lahu jo mele preetam mohi ||
lines.translation: I will search for someone, some friend, who will unite me with my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai melaaiaa jat dekhaa tat soi ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has united me with Him; wherever I look, there He is.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak so prabh seviaa tis jevad avar na koi ||2||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak serves that God; there is no other as great as He is. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: devanahaar daataar kit mukh saalaaheeai ||
lines.translation: He is the Great Giver, the Generous Lord; with what mouth can I praise Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਖੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis rakhai kirapaa dhaar rijak samaaheeai ||
lines.translation: In His Mercy, He protects, preserves and sustains us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਵਸਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਇਕ ਧਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: koi na kis hee vas sabhanaa ik dhar ||
lines.translation: No one is under anyone else's control; He is the One Support of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਲੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਵਾਗਿ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: paale baalak vaag de kai aap kar ||
lines.translation: He cherishes all as His children, and reaches out with His hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਦਾ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: karadaa anad binod kichhoo na jaaneeai ||
lines.translation: He stages His joyous plays, which no one understands at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab dhaar samarath hau tis kurabaaneeai ||
lines.translation: The all-powerful Lord gives His Support to all; I am a sacrifice to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਈਐ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤੁ ਗਾਵਣ ਜੋਗਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaaeeai raat dina(n)t gaavan jogiaa ||
lines.translation: Night and day, sing the Praises of the One who is worthy of being praised.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo gur kee pairee paahi tinee har ras bhogiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Those who fall at the Guru's Feet, enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੀੜਹੁ ਮੋਕਲਾਈ ਕੀਤੀਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਰਖੇ ਕੁਟੰਬੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bheeRahu mokalaaee keeteean sabh rakhe kuta(n)bai naal ||
lines.translation: He has widened the narrow path for me, and preserved my integrity, along with that of my family.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaraj aap savaarian so prabh sadaa sabhaal ||
lines.translation: He Himself has arranged and resolved my affairs. I dwell upon that God forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਲਹੁੜੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh maat pitaa ka(n)th laaidaa lahuRe baalak paal ||
lines.translation: God is my mother and father; He hugs me close in His embrace, and cherishes me, like His tiny baby.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: daiaal hoe sabh jee ja(n)tr har naanak nadar nihaal ||1||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures have become kind and compassionate to me. O Nanak, the Lord has blessed me with His Glance of Grace. ||1||
